description: GitHub repo stats and latest release. GitHub repository snapshot: stars, forks, open issues, watchers, language, license, topics, created/pushed dates, default branch, latest release (tag, date) and archived flag. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"repo":"coinbase/x402","stars":1000,"forks":200,"openIssues":50,"language":"TypeScript","license":"Apache-2.0","latestRelease":{"tag":"v1.0.0","publishedAt":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}. Price: $0.0024 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
